# Rivira Tech

> AI training and applied AI delivery. Instructor-led programmes for students,
> developers, non-technical professionals and enterprise teams, plus project
> and proof-of-concept work built on the same stack the courses teach.

Training is project-first: every programme ends in something the learner has
built and can show. Courses run in modules with live implementation rather than
recorded lectures, and completion carries a verified certificate.

## Programmes

- [AI For Kids](https://www.riviratech.com/ai-for-kids): 12 modules for ages 10-20. Python basics, machine learning, neural networks, NLP and a final project. No prior experience.
- [AI For Coders](https://www.riviratech.com/ai-for-coders): Python fundamentals through production AI — LLMs, RAG systems, agents and cloud deployment.
- [AI For Non-Coders](https://www.riviratech.com/ai-for-non-coders): No-code AI tools for business decisions, marketing automation and workflows. 8-module and 16-module tracks.
- [GenAI For Business](https://www.riviratech.com/genai-for-business): Applying generative AI to real business problems — prompt engineering, marketing and content, workflow automation.
- [AI Stack](https://www.riviratech.com/ai-stack): The full enterprise stack — agents, agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, MCP and AI automation, with production deployment.
- [Corporate Training](https://www.riviratech.com/corporate-training): Customised programmes for teams, sized to the organisation and its industry.

- [All courses](https://www.riviratech.com/courses): Every programme, filterable.

- [Enrol](https://www.riviratech.com/enroll): Enrolment form. Pay by card, or submit and receive a payment request.
- [Business and projects](https://www.riviratech.com/business): Applied AI delivery — proofs of concept and production builds.
- [Blog](https://www.riviratech.com/blogs): Written explainers on LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompting and related topics.
- [Contact](https://www.riviratech.com/contact): Enquiries. Replies within one business day. Career advisor: +91 72073 01237, info@riviratech.com.

## Notes for agents

- Student accounts, assignments and certificates live under `/portal`, which requires sign-in and is not crawlable.
- `/panel` is staff-only administration. Do not index or attempt to access it.
- Course prices and schedules are not published on the site; they come from the enquiry or enrolment flow.
- Canonical host is `https://www.riviratech.com`. The apex redirects to it.
